```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# 1. 데이터 로드 (파일 경로에 맞게 지정해주세요)
efl_df <- read_csv("EFL.csv")

# 2. 경기별 승점 계산 함수
get_home_points <- function(result) {
  ifelse(result == "H", 3, ifelse(result == "D", 1, 0))
}

get_away_points <- function(result) {
  ifelse(result == "A", 3, ifelse(result == "D", 1, 0))
}

efl_df <- efl_df %>%
  mutate(
    HomePoints = get_home_points(`FT Result`),
    AwayPoints = get_away_points(`FT Result`)
  )

# 3. 홈 팀 기준 시즌별 집계
home_stats <- efl_df %>%
  group_by(Season, HomeTeam) %>%
  summarise(
    Matches = n(),
    Goals_Scored = sum(`FTH Goals`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Goals_Conceded = sum(`FTA Goals`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shots = sum(`H Shots`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shots_Against = sum(`A Shots`, na.rm = TRUE),
    SOT = sum(`H SOT`, na.rm = TRUE),
    SOT_Against = sum(`A SOT`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Yellow = sum(`H Yellow`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Red = sum(`H Red`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Points = sum(HomePoints, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Team = HomeTeam)

# 4. 원정 팀 기준 시즌별 집계
away_stats <- efl_df %>%
  group_by(Season, AwayTeam) %>%
  summarise(
    Matches = n(),
    Goals_Scored = sum(`FTA Goals`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Goals_Conceded = sum(`FTH Goals`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shots = sum(`A Shots`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shots_Against = sum(`H Shots`, na.rm = TRUE),
    SOT = sum(`A SOT`, na.rm = TRUE),
    SOT_Against = sum(`H SOT`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Yellow = sum(`A Yellow`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Red = sum(`A Red`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Points = sum(AwayPoints, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Team = AwayTeam)

# 5. 홈 + 원정 통합하여 시즌별 팀 종합 통계 생성
team_season <- bind_rows(home_stats, away_stats) %>%
  group_by(Season, Team) %>%
  summarise(
    Matches = sum(Matches),
    Goals_Scored = sum(Goals_Scored),
    Goals_Conceded = sum(Goals_Conceded),
    Shots = sum(Shots),
    Shots_Against = sum(Shots_Against),
    SOT = sum(SOT),
    SOT_Against = sum(SOT_Against),
    Yellow = sum(Yellow),
    Red = sum(Red),
    Points = sum(Points),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Goal_Difference = Goals_Scored - Goals_Conceded,
    Shooting_Efficiency = Goals_Scored / Shots,
    Shot_Accuracy = SOT / Shots,
    Defensive_Resilience = Goals_Conceded / SOT_Against
  )

head(team_season)
```

```{r}
# 시즌별로 승점 기준 순위를 매기고, 상위 3팀을 승격(1), 나머지는 0으로 레이블링
team_season <- team_season %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = dense_rank(desc(Points)), # 동점자 처리를 고려한 순위 산정
    Promoted = ifelse(Rank <= 3, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 승격 팀 레이블이 잘 생성되었는지 확인
table(team_season$Season, team_season$Promoted)
```

```{r}
# 로지스틱 회귀 모델 적합 (데이터의 스케일링을 위해 scale() 적용 가능)
logit_model <- glm(Promoted ~ Goals_Scored + Goals_Conceded + Shooting_Efficiency + Defensive_Resilience, 
                   data = team_season, 
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"))

# 모델 요약 및 오즈비(Odds Ratio) 확인
summary(logit_model)

# 계수의 오즈비(Odds Ratio)와 95% 신뢰구간 계산
exp(coef(logit_model))
exp(confint(logit_model))
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)

# 결측치 제거 및 범주형 변환
rf_data <- team_season %>%
  select(Promoted, Goals_Scored, Goals_Conceded, Shots, SOT, Yellow, Red, 
         Goal_Difference, Shooting_Efficiency, Shot_Accuracy, Defensive_Resilience) %>%
  na.omit()

rf_data$Promoted <- as.factor(rf_data$Promoted)

# 랜덤 포레스트 모델 학습
set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(Promoted ~ ., data = rf_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# 모델 결과 및 변수 중요도(Variable Importance) 확인
print(rf_model)
importance(rf_model)
varImpPlot(rf_model)
```
